metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD - gameconfig + dlclist patch
metadata.description:
Edits mods\update\update.rpf. Install to the mods folder. Works for GTA V Legacy and Enhanced. Part of the GTA VI-Inspired HUD, a fork of FBICat's VI HUD. Help with this version: discord.gg/C7gE5SHEzH.
dlclist.xml adds dlcpacks:/vihudfonts/ and dlcpacks:/vihudanims/ (Lucia's package adds hers) gameconfig.xml MetaDataStore 4000, ExprDictStore 400, TxdStore 150000, DwdStore 30000, MaxExtraPedModelInfos 600
1.3: registers Lucia again and raises MetaDataStore (3200 by default), the pool her ped files overflowed while the game was loading. With all packs registered the game uses about 3208 MetaDataStore, 90874 TxdStore and 21194 DwdStore slots, so all three stock limits (3200 / 80200 / 20500) must be raised. 1.5: Lucia is a separate package from 2.5.1 and registers her own packs, so this patch lists only the HUD's. Installs that already list Lucia's packs keep them. 1.4: each pack is only added when dlclist.xml doesn't list it yet, so no pack can end up listed twice; the pool sizes are set, never added to. 1.6: the pool sizes come first, so installing it again (or over an older version) always sets them. If the HUD's packs are already listed, the installer stops there and may say the install FAILED ("Unable to find XML Node"): that only means they're registered already, and nothing is wrong.
